evidence_policy: Append by stable inherited ID; retain historical source/contract/results. Old evidence never automatically verifies a revision 1.3 feature.

compatibility_preservation.policy: Keep the separately pinned .py source/production surface and historical coverage/evidence. NAJA-only grammar and coercions do not erase or reinterpret supported .py.

migrations.reason: NAJA 2026.1 becomes independently versioned while the pinned .py grammar, source behavior and compatibility evidence remain distinct obligations.
General suite braces and transparent labels expand the former depth/alias-only contract; clause ownership, scope, mixed delimiter stacks and tool/cell spans require new tests.
Expanded module/function/Unicode alias contracts need scope, conflict, precedence and cache revalidation without textual rewriting.
Value/reference representation, objects/protocols/inference and numeric policy require executable proof; the explicit-i64 seed cannot close hosted semantics.
Scoped extension/coherence rules add lookup and ownership obligations without replacing inherited object/module behavior.
Authorized partial directories add deterministic path/layout/member checks to inherited object/module/build contracts.
User-defined typed literals add lexical/resolution/exactness obligations; no implicit narrowing or official-name special cases.
General scale/affine derivation adds algebra/promotion/dimension/point/delta checks while preserving inherited numeric semantics.
Refinements and immutable typed captures expand validation into checked structural values with boundary/work/lifetime invariants.
Native built-in structured parsers add domain-specific validation/property/round-trip obligations without DNS or ad hoc splitting.
NAJA contextual constant conversion and reductions expand semantics; .py repetition/conversion behavior and previous evidence cannot be silently reinterpreted.
Bounded native numerical/data foundations add shapes/views/effects/precision while preserving CSV/JSONL, resources and productivity obligations.
Native CPU parallelism, structured concurrency and real typed application-input events expand earlier async/network contracts.
General braces do not introduce a networking DSL; framing, lifecycle, hardware permissions and numerical/local quantum demonstrations remain mandatory.
Truthful inspect/explain, controlled derive and effect/shape/contract trust need new acceptance; no invented costs, purity or global optimality.

continuity_contracts.title: Distinguish the limits
continuity_contracts.contract: Track actual exposed context, provider quota, rate, deadline and spend separately; unknown telemetry stays unknown, with supported responses only.

continuity_contracts.title: Budget-aware work units
continuity_contracts.contract: Bound work by assigned scope/checks/checkpoint plans and reserve available capacity for verification; warnings trigger durable recovery without waived tests.

continuity_contracts.title: Durable state, separate from chat
continuity_contracts.contract: Persist atomic factual checkpoint/source/dirty/test/artifact/owner/next-command state; retain last verified source and uncommitted or WIP work honestly.

continuity_contracts.title: One integrator, real coordination
continuity_contracts.contract: Enforce one actual integrator, atomic local reservations and verified ownership transfer; no timestamp-only reclaim or fictitious receiver.

continuity_contracts.title: Automatic continuation, only when supported
continuity_contracts.contract: Discover supported continuation/manual resume; any optional supervisor is bounded, permission-aware and tested, with no paid/credential/account/persistent-service bypass.

continuity_contracts.title: Verification of recovery itself
continuity_contracts.contract: Exercise fresh-agent recovery and explicit local crash/quota simulations, dirty/stale/conflicting state, unknown budgets and preserved failing work; label simulations.

continuity_contracts.title: Progress and stop behavior
continuity_contracts.contract: Publish factual progress and exact stop/resume causes, actual receiver state and next commands; continue independent ready work rather than false completion.
